query: insert into list_memberships (workspace_id, contact_id, list_id, status, subscribed_at, source) select $1, $2, l, 'subscribed', now(), $4::text from unnest($3::uuid[]) l on conflict (contact_id, list_id) do update set status = 'subscribed', subscribed_at = now(), source = excluded.source where list_memberships.status = 'pending' returning list_id
